subject: Unexpected staging traffic causing March overage / request for credit
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgewave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Sudden March spike + auto-pay hold

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. Our finance team noticed a large usage line on the March invoice (invoice #9273) that looks inconsistent with our typical traffic. The bank also put the scheduled auto-pay on hold because the payment amount jumped >300% versus our normal.

We’ve attached the screenshot from our billing system and would appreciate a per-hour breakdown from your side for Mar 14–15 so we can reconcile. We suspect a test/run from our side may have hit production keys, but need your logs to be sure.

Can you flag this as urgent and let us know if you can issue a provisional credit while we investigate? We’re in EU and will need the VAT treatment clarified if a credit is issued.

Thanks,
Liam
Finance Manager, EdgeWave
[attachment: client-screenshot-amount.png]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Sudden March spike + auto-pay hold

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads-up and sorry for the hassle. I’ve pulled an hourly export for EdgeWave for 2026-03-14 00:00 UTC through 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC and attached per_account-hourly-usage-export.csv. Early read: there is a concentrated burst between 2026-03-14T18:00Z and 2026-03-14T20:30Z with a high token-per-request rate coming from two distinct API keys.

Initial hypothesis: a CI/staging job that renewed an old SDK key without environment tagging and replayed a large batch of requests. We’ll escalate to the support logs and the runtime team to confirm whether those requests were attributable to a staging agent vs. production. I’m opening a ticket and will share the replay logs in the thread.

For now we can do a provisional, reversible credit equal to the overage line while we complete the investigation — we don’t want your auto-pay to fail. Ben, can you confirm the max provisional credit we can apply without Finance sign-off? Also, Liam — can you confirm whether EdgeWave is VAT-registered in Ireland (or provide a VAT ID) so we can handle the tax side correctly?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: per_account-hourly-usage-export.csv]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Sudden March spike + auto-pay hold

Thanks Priya — I’ve provisionally approved a temporary credit up to EUR 6,500 or the full overage amount (whichever is smaller) to unblock their payment processing. Please mark it as provisional and tie it to the internal ticket (HubSpot #8271). Marissa — we’ll need reconciliation notes and the final root cause before we convert this provisional credit to permanent. Also confirm any VAT implications if the customer is EU VAT-registered (reverse charge vs. refundable VAT).

Ben Carter
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgewave.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-16T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Sudden March spike + auto-pay hold

Hi all — I took a deeper look into the runtime traces and the staging replay logs we pulled from our ingest pipeline (support-replay-log.txt attached). Key findings: 

- Traffic pattern: 2026-03-14T18:03Z–2026-03-14T20:28Z, ~1.2M tokens, ~9,200 requests; token/request ratio atypically high (long batch generation).
- Source keys: two keys associated with EdgeWave org; one matches a historic key that was marked as inactive in their console but still valid on our backend due to a delayed revocation (race during key rotation).
- Replay evidence: our logs show a replayed job originating from an IP range that maps to EdgeWave’s CI provider. Payloads include the same session_id prefix seen in their staging runs.

Root cause: staging job replayed large batches using a non-environment-tagged key that was not fully revoked on our side during rotation. This produced legitimate billable requests.

Recommended remediation and commercial treatment: 
- Apply a one-time credit for 85% of the overage (we recommend this split because a portion of the requests were indistinguishable from intentional production traffic).
- Waive the bank late-fee/penalty for this cycle.
- Update the invoice to show the credit as a negative line item and include a note about reverse-charge VAT treatment if EdgeWave provides a valid EU VAT ID.

I’ve run the numbers and the calculated credit would be EUR 5,340 on invoice #9273. I’ve attached the reconciliation export and the raw replay snippet for your review. If you accept these terms we’ll post the credit and issue an updated invoice PDF.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
[attachment: support-replay-log.txt]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgewave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-16T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Sudden March spike + auto-pay hold

Thanks Marissa — that matches what our engineering team saw on the SDK side. EdgeWave is VAT-registered (IE1234567A). We accept the proposed remediation: 85% credit of the identified overage and waiver of the late fee. Please proceed and provide an updated invoice indicating reverse-charge VAT (we will self-account).

Can you confirm when the provisional credit will post to our account and whether this will affect our March recurring commitment calculation? Also please send the updated invoice PDF so we can clear the bank hold.

—Liam
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-17T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Sudden March spike + auto-pay hold

Hi Liam — thanks and glad we could confirm quickly. Actions completed: 

- Posted a provisional credit of EUR 5,340 to EdgeWave’s account (visible in the billing portal within 2 hours). This is marked provisional and will convert to permanent once we close the reconciliation ticket.
- Generated an updated invoice (#9273-rev1) with a negative line for the credit and VAT section noting reverse-charge (attached updated-invoice-#9273.pdf).
- Waived the late payment penalty for this cycle.

Timing: the credit shows on your account now; refunds/settlements from payment processors typically take 3–5 business days depending on your bank. The provisional credit will not change your committed monthly baseline for quota calculations — it only adjusts the current invoice line. If you want the committed baseline changed we can open a separate change request.

Please confirm receipt of the updated invoice and I’ll close HubSpot ticket #8271. If you’d like, we can schedule a quick post-mortem with our runtime and your engineering team to set up key-rotation guardrails to prevent this in future.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: updated-invoice-#9273.pdf]
